name: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services in China. It operates through Corporate Finance business, Personal Finance business, Capital business, and Other businesses segments. The company offers personal banking services including private banking; investment and financing; personal savings; investment and wealth management; personal exchange; personal loans; payment, and welfare and sport lottery agency; and consumer finance services.
